findings.text: D8 freezes the whole retention-test docstring, but the pilot’s `Sql.check_send_plainInsert` proof sketch contains a checked reference to `Sql.check_send_of_step`, which D12 says the slice deletes. Fix: Preserve the name of the deleted law under test and update the proof sketch and its checked references when the proof changes.

Requiring every witness to use only declarations that survive the slice forces the pilot’s send witnesses to duplicate `ReplacedStepLaws.plainInsert_database` even when all three witnesses pass Nix together and retire together. Fix: Allow a witness to use another witness through their common acceptance revision when both retire together and their proofs use only surviving library contracts.

D12 identifies one slice-8 revision as the last contract change for every remaining witness, but owner decision 3 allows a unique witness to remain after its own contracts last changed in an earlier slice. Fix: Record the Nix-accepted revision of the last relevant contract change for each witness and retain unique coverage until a caller or focused test replaces it.
